title: Shurpanakha accuses Ravana
introduction: Shuurpanakha taunts Ravana for his un-kingly activities, by which his kingdom is going to face a calamitous situation soon. While gibing at him she narrates how a king, really fit for kingship, shall conduct the affairs of kingdom. She speaks many paradigms on which many commentaries are declined basing on kings and their vices.

This chapter vies with the 33rd chapter of Kishkindha Kanda in the attitudes of a king and his kingship. These two chapters, as detailed by ancient commentators, equally deal with raaja niiti shastra 'political science' and there in Kishkindha the only rescue to Sugreeva is Tara, who saves the face of Sugreeva before Lakshmana, whereas in here Ravana has none to come to his aid when chided by Shuurpanakha. Though Shuurpanakha is a sultry and harpy demoness, the Sage Valmiki has put some rational words on her tongue in forewarning Ravana.
closing: इति वाल्मीकि रामायणे आदि काव्ये अरण्य काण्डे त्रयः त्रिंशः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 33rd chapter in Aranya Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
ततः शूर्पणखा दीना रावणम् लोक रावणम् |
अमात्य मध्ये संक्रुद्धा परुषम् वाक्यम् अब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tataḥ śūrpaṇakhā dīnā rāvaṇam loka rāvaṇam |
amātya madhye saṅkruddhā paruṣam vākyam abravīt
verses.translation: Then that doleful Shuurpanakha spoke these scornful words to Ravana who makes the world to wail in the presence of his ministers.

glosses.meaning: ministers, amid - in the presence of
world, on who makes to wail

verses.devanagari:
प्रमत्तः काम भोगेषु स्वैर वृत्तो निरंकुशः |
समुत्पन्नम् भयम् घोरम् बोद्धव्यम् न अवबुध्यसे
verses.iast:
pramattaḥ kāma bhogeṣu svaira vṛtto niraṃkuśaḥ |
samutpannam bhayam ghoram boddhavyam na avabudhyase
verses.translation: "Highly infatuated with lustful gratifications you are incontinent and unchecked, thus you are unobservant of a calamitous jeopardy that has surfaced, though you ought to be observant of it as a king.

glosses.meaning: that which is to be known

verses.devanagari:
सक्तम् ग्राम्येषु भोगेषु काम वृत्तम् महीपतिम् |
लुब्धम् न बहु मन्यन्ते श्मशान अग्निम् इव प्रजाः
verses.iast:
saktam grāmyeṣu bhogeṣu kāma vṛttam mahīpatim |
lubdham na bahu manyante śmaśāna agnim iva prajāḥ
verses.translation: "If a king deports himself in an overly self-assured manner, that too with self-serving motives, and clings only to dirty pleasures, he will be unhonoured by people as with a crematory fire.
notes: For those who are self-centred there will be no fear, no shame. artha āturāṇām na gurur na bandhuḥ | kāma āturāṇām na bhayam na lajja | kṣudha āturāṇām na rucir na pakvam | vidya āturā ṇām na sukham na nidrā -- nīti śāstra 'for money-mongers no venerable ones, no relative... for lust-mongers no fear, no shame... for food-mongers no taste, no proper baking... for education-mongers, no comfort, no sleep...' morals.

glosses.meaning: self, driven - deports in overly self-assured manner, swaggeringly
in crematory ground, fire - crematory-fire, like

verses.devanagari:
स्वयम् कार्याणि यः काले न अनुतिष्ठति पार्थिवः |
स तु वै सह राज्येन तैः च कार्यैः विनश्यति
verses.iast:
svayam kāryāṇi yaḥ kāle na anutiṣṭhati pārthivaḥ |
sa tu vai saha rājyena taiḥ ca kāryaiḥ vinaśyati
verses.translation: "The king who will not deal with the concerns of kingdom, in person and on time, he and his kingdom and even those concerns of his kingdom will get ruined.
notes: This can also be expressed as: ssaḥ taiḥ kāryaiḥ saha rājyena ca vinaśyati'...by those very issues of kingdom, the king along with his kingdom gets ruined...' because the major issue on hand is Rama and Lakshmana and they can ruin Ravana and his kingdom. Inordinate revelling in comforts and lust makes a king weak in body, mind, and time. The timely actions he is supposed to take do not come to mind because mind is weakened and benumbed. Then he is liable to believe his aids that may precisely land him into further troubles. Hence a king / ruler has to take actions and decisions personally, on time, duly remaining firm by his body and mind.

verses.devanagari:
अयुक्त चारम् दुर्दर्शम् अस्वाधीनम् नराधिपम् |
वर्जयन्ति नरा दूरात् नदी पंकम् इव द्विपाः
verses.iast:
ayukta cāram durdarśam asvādhīnam narādhipam |
varjayanti narā dūrāt nadī paṃkam iva dvipāḥ
verses.translation: "If a king is inaccessible to spies for exchange of information, unavailable for subjects for an audience for a similar appraisal, more so if he is intemperately not able to impose self-discipline, people will eschew such a king from a distance as elephants will refrain themselves from the mud of river from a distance.
notes: Shuurpanakha knows that Ravana has spies all around, but she is also in the know that they are worthless fellows because they narrate mythologies after every thing is ruined, as was done by Akampana in the previous episode. There is none to caution him beforehand excepting herself, that is her confidence. So, she is haranguing Ravana to take immediate action, otherwise, there may be a mutiny or cold war in his kingdom, and his subjects may desert him during wartime, like Vibheeshana.

glosses.meaning: not, with, spies - inaccessible to spies
impossible, to see [unavailable for an audience]
not, in one's own, control - not, self-possessed, intemperate

verses.devanagari:
ये न रक्षन्ति विषयम् अस्वाधीना नराधिपः |
ते न वृद्ध्या प्रकाशन्ते गिरयः सागरे यथा
verses.iast:
ye na rakṣanti viṣayam asvādhīnā narādhipaḥ |
te na vṛddhyā prakāśante girayaḥ sāgare yathā
verses.translation:
"Which of those kings that will not safeguard their kingdoms by remaining in a self-restrained manner, they will not outshine advantageously, like mountains submerged under ocean.

"Without keeping the kingdom under your personal control, you have shuffled the administration onto the ministers and army personnel like Khara, Duushana et al. And these figureheads alone become the tiderips, for they quarrel among themselves about the kingship of Lanka after your ruin, and they alone are floating like oceanic tides up above your head and thus you are a submerged sovereign. In any way, your doom is destined either by Rama, who is an imminent danger, or by your military managers, who are the in-built dangers."
notes: Ravana is no doubt mountainous in his wealth and prosperity but he is engulfed in the ocean called promiscuity, and as long as those waters of lust tiderip over his head he cannot surface himself.

verses.devanagari:
आत्मवद्भिः विगृह्य त्वम् देव गंधर्व दानवैः |
अयुक्त चारः चपलः कथम् राजा भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
ātmavadbhiḥ vigṛhya tvam deva gaṃdharva dānavaiḥ |
ayukta cāraḥ capalaḥ katham rājā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "Externally you are belligerent with sensible gods, gandharva-s and other demons, and internally you are needful of intelligence agents, and such as you are, you are an erratic even, then how can you thrive as a king!
notes: Your enmity with the sensible gods will make them sensitive to be vigilant. And because there is a lack of intelligence or agents to you, added to it there is a lack of your own personal intelligence required for a king, and above all there is a lacking in the insistence of real kingship with you. Then, will not those gods take opportunity to hit you back, for everything is lacking in you, except lusting?'

glosses.meaning: with clear-headed ones [sensible gods etc - externally]
without, having [not employed - needful of, internally] intelligence agents

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् तु बाल स्वभावत् च बुद्धि हीनः च राक्षस |
ज्ञातव्यम् तु न जानीषि कथम् राजा भविष्यसि
verses.iast:
tvam tu bāla svabhāvat ca buddhi hīnaḥ ca rākśasa |
GYātavyam tu na jānīṣi katham rājā bhaviṣyasi
verses.translation: "Your bent is boyish and you are mindless, oh, demon, you are not able to know the knowable danger because you are carefree, and how do you thrive as a king!

glosses.meaning: you, but, of boyish, attitude [bent,] also
knowable, but, not, knowing - because you are carefree

verses.devanagari:
येषाम् चारः च कोशः च नयः च जयताम् वर |
अस्वाधीना नरेन्द्राणाम् प्राकृतैः ते जनैः समाः
verses.iast:
yeṣām cāraḥ ca kośaḥ ca nayaḥ ca jayatām vara |
asvādhīnā narendrāṇām prākṛtaiḥ te janaiḥ samāḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, so-called best one among triumphant kings, those kings that do not retain spies, treasuries and strategies under their control, but vouchsafe them to others, they are of a piece with the peasantry.

glosses.meaning: oh, among triumphant ones, best one - in dissent, sarcastically

glosses.itrans: caaraH ca koshaH ca nayaH ca
glosses.iast: cāraḥ ca kośaḥ ca nayaḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: चारः च कोशः च नयः च

glosses.meaning: not, in, one's own control -if they do not retain
peasant, people, equal to - tantamount to.

verses.devanagari:
यस्मात् पश्यन्ति दूरस्थान् सर्वान् अर्थान् नराधिपाः |
चारेण तस्मात् उच्यन्ते राजानो दीर्घ चक्षुषः
verses.iast:
yasmāt paśyanti dūrasthān sarvān arthān narādhipāḥ |
cāreṇa tasmāt ucyante rājāno dīrgha cakṣuṣaḥ
verses.translation: "Oh, titular overlord of humans, only some can be called prescient kings because they see all the situations happening distantly through their spies.
notes: Though the spies bring in various pieces of information they are to be collated and analysed by the king. anena cāreṇa vyavahitā api arthā avaśyam vicāraṇīyā iti sūcitam - dk'so you neither have those intelligent spies nor the least intelligence required of a 'prescient king' thus your doom is certain.'

glosses.meaning: oh, humans, overlord of - in dissent

verses.devanagari:
अयुक्त चारम् मन्ये त्वाम् प्राकृतैः सचिवैः युतः |
स्व जनम् च जनस्थानम् निहतम् न अवबुध्यसे
verses.iast:
ayukta cāram manye tvām prākṛtaiḥ sacivaiḥ yutaḥ |
sva janam ca janasthānam nihatam na avabudhyase
verses.translation: "I believe that you have no spies worth their profession, yet you are associated with artless ministers worthy to worship you, hence you are incognisant of the ruination of all of your subjects in Janasthaana, including Janasthaana.

glosses.meaning: without, having [appointed,] spies - maladroit in organising spies
with artless, ministers, one associated with

verses.devanagari:
चतुर्दश सहस्राणि रक्षसाम् भीम कर्मणाम् |
हतानि एकेन रामेण खरः च सह दूषणः
verses.iast:
caturdaśa sahasrāṇi rakṣasām bhīma karmaṇām |
hatāni ekena rāmeṇa kharaḥ ca saha dūṣaṇaḥ
verses.translation: "A single soul called Rama has eliminated fourteen thousand demons of dreadful deeds in Janasthaana, even Duushana is killed, even Khara is also killed.

verses.devanagari:
ऋषीणाम् अभयम् दत्तम् कृत क्षेमाः च दण्डकाः |
धर्षितम् च जनस्थानम् रामेण अक्लिष्ट कारिणा
verses.iast:
ṛṣīṇām abhayam dattam kṛta kṣemāḥ ca daṇḍakāḥ |
dharṣitam ca janasthānam rāmeṇa akliṣṭa kāriṇā
verses.translation: "That indefatigable champion Rama gave security to the sages, rendered Dandaka forest safeguarded, and he put Janasthaana to rout.

glosses.meaning: without, fatigue [indefatigable,] performer of deeds - champion
made, safeguard - rendered safe, as well
Janasthaana, assailed - put to rout, also.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् तु लुब्धः प्रमत्तः च पराधीनः च रावण |
विषये स्वे समुत्पन्नम् यो भयम् न अवबुध्यसे
verses.iast:
tvam tu lubdhaḥ pramattaḥ ca parādhīnaḥ ca rāvaṇa |
viṣaye sve samutpannam yo bhayam na avabudhyase
verses.translation: "On your part you are but selfish, hotheaded, and others like the appeasers of your lust, or these artless ministers, or those underpaid unfaithful spies hold you down, and such as you are, you are unperceptive of the calamity rising up against you in your own kingdom.

glosses.meaning: in other's, control, also - controlled by promiscuity

verses.devanagari:
तीक्ष्णम् अल्प प्रदातारम् प्रमत्तम् गर्वितम् शठम् |
व्यसने सर्व भूतानि न अभिधावन्ति पार्थिवम्
verses.iast:
tīkṣṇam alpa pradātāram pramattam garvitam śaṭham |
vyasane sarva bhūtāni na abhidhāvanti pārthivam
verses.translation: "Should a king be overweening, an under-payer, an improvident, self-conceited, and dubious, all his subjects bid goodbye to such a king when he is in strife.

glosses.meaning: not, towards, run - bid goodbye to such a king.

verses.devanagari:
अतिमानिनम् अग्राह्यम् आत्म संभावितम् नरम् |
क्रोधिनम् व्यसने हन्ति स्व जनो अपि नराधिपम्
verses.iast:
atimāninam agrāhyam ātma sambhāvitam naram |
krodhinam vyasane hanti sva jano api narādhipam
verses.translation: "Should a ruler be unduly self-conceited, self-centred, self-adulating and a spitfire too, his own kith and kin will ruin him when he is in distress.

glosses.meaning: such a man - here such a demon
own, people, even - kith and kin

verses.devanagari:
न अनुतिष्ठति कार्याणि भयेषु न बिभेति च |
क्षिप्रम् राज्यात् च्युतो दीनः तृणैः तुल्यो भवेत् इह
verses.iast:
na anutiṣṭhati kāryāṇi bhayeṣu na bibheti ca |
kṣipram rājyāt cyuto dīnaḥ tṛṇaiḥ tulyo bhavet iha
verses.translation: "That king who does not officiate his good offices, nor un-panicked into panicky situations, he will be quickly overthrown from his kingdom, and on becoming a debased individual he will be equated with a piece of straw in this world.

glosses.meaning: in panicky [situations, who is] not, panicked, also
quickly, from kingdom, on falling - when overthrown
piece of straw, equated, he will be.

verses.devanagari:
शुष्क काष्ठैः भवेत् कार्यम् लोष्टैः अपि च पांसुभिः |
न तु स्थानात् परिभ्रष्टैः कार्यम् स्यात् वसुधाधिपैः
verses.iast:
śuṣka kāṣṭhaiḥ bhavet kāryam loṣṭaiḥ api ca pāṃsubhiḥ |
na tu sthānāt paribhraṣṭaiḥ kāryam syāt vasudhādhipaiḥ
verses.translation: "Dried sticks, globs or the particles of dust are of some avail, but kings fallen from their position are of no avail.

glosses.meaning: with particles of dust, even, also
there will be, [some] utility [they are of some avail]
utility is not, there they are of no avail.

verses.devanagari:
उपभुक्तम् यथा वासः स्रजो वा मृदिता यथा |
एवम् राज्यात् परिभ्रष्टः समर्थो अपि निरर्थकः
verses.iast:
upabhuktam yathā vāsaḥ srajo vā mṛditā yathā |
evam rājyāt paribhraṣṭaḥ samartho api nirarthakaḥ
verses.translation: "As to how a used up raiment or a crumpled flower-tassel is meaningless, likewise a king derelict from his kingdom, though functional, is meaningless.

glosses.meaning: not, of any means [meaningless, of no avail.]

verses.devanagari:
अप्रमत्तः च यो राजा सर्वज्ञो विजितेन्द्रियः |
कृतज्ञो धर्म शीलः च स राजा तिष्ठते चिरम्
verses.iast:
apramattaḥ ca yo rājā sarvaGYo vijitendriyaḥ |
kṛtaGYo dharma śīlaḥ ca sa rājā tiṣṭhate ciram
verses.translation: "Which king will be cautious, clever, conscientious, with his controlled senses, and thankful, that king survives for a long time.

glosses.meaning: that, king, for a long time, stays - survives.

verses.devanagari:
नयनाभ्याम् प्रसुप्तो वा जागर्ति नय चक्षुषा |
व्यक्त क्रोध प्रसादः च स राजा पूज्यते जनैः
verses.iast:
nayanābhyām prasupto vā jāgarti naya cakṣuṣā |
vyakta krodha prasādaḥ ca sa rājā pūjyate janaiḥ
verses.translation:
"He who keeps his mental eyes of wariness will be wakeful even though he slept well closing his physical eyes and he who will make his fury and favour evident to people without any concealment or cunningness, people will highly revere him as a king.

"He who keeps his mental eyes of wariness wakeful even though he sleeps fast closing his physical eyes, thus discarded are his fury and frenzy as well, because he knows as to who is to be treated furiously and who is to be favoured, and thus people will revere him as a judicious king.

glosses.itrans: [in other mms: tyakta krodhaH pramaadaH ca
glosses.iast: [in other mms: tyakta krodhaḥ pramādaḥ ca
glosses.devanagari: [इन् ओथेर् म्म्स्: त्यक्त क्रोधः प्रमादः च

glosses.meaning: that, king, by people, will be revered.

verses.devanagari:
त्वम् तु रावण दुर्बुद्धिः गुणैः एतैः विवर्जितः |
यस्य ते अविदितः चारैः रक्षसाम् सुमहान् वधः
verses.iast:
tvam tu rāvaṇa dur.hbuddhiḥ guṇaiḥ etaiḥ vivarjitaḥ |
yasya te aviditaḥ cāraiḥ rakṣasām sumahān vadhaḥ
verses.translation: "But, oh, Ravana, because you are imprudent you are bereft of these merits, and such as you are, unknown is the very great massacre of demons to you, though not personally, but at least through your spies.

glosses.meaning: not, known - though not personally, but art least thru spies it is not known to you.

verses.devanagari:
पर अवमंता विषयेषु संगवान्
न देश काल प्रविभाग तत्त्व वित् |
अयुक्त बुद्धिः गुण दोष निश्चये
विपन्न राज्यो न चिरात् विपत्स्यते
verses.iast:
para avamaṃtā viṣayeṣu saṃgavān
na deśa kāla pravibhāga tattva vit |
ayukta buddhiḥ guṇa doṣa niścaye
vipanna rājyo na cirāt vipatsyate
verses.translation: "You are the humiliator of others, you hobnob only with your ravishes, and incognisant of the object for apportionment of time and place for your activities, as to when and where and how the things are to be dealt with. And, as you are not attending any kingly activity, or do not focus your mind in deciding rights and wrongs, thereby your kingdom will get ruined and you will be imperilled, not before long." Thus Shuurpanakha declaimed Ravana about his worthlessness as a king.
notes: However self-sufficient and self-assured a king might be, he cannot underestimate rivalling kings as trivial, unilaterally.anena susamṛddha rājyastho api rājā etaiḥ doṣaiḥ acirāt rājya bhrṣṭo bhavati iti - rājñā baliṣṭena api śatru durbala iti avamatiḥ na kartavyam ca sūcitam - dk It is indicated that a king should be on his guard lest he will be overthrown, just because that king is associated with many un-kingly attitudes.

glosses.itrans: na desha kaala pra vibhaaga tattva vit
glosses.iast: na deśa kāla pra vibhāga tattva vit
glosses.devanagari: न देश काल प्र विभाग तत्त्व वित्
glosses.meaning: [you are] not, place, time, well, dived up [apportion,] object, cognisant of

verses.devanagari:
इति स्व दोषान् परिकीर्तिताम् तया
समीक्ष्य बुद्ध्या क्षणदा चरेश्वरः |
धनेन दर्पेण बलेन च अन्वितो
विचिन्तयामास चिरम् स रावणः
verses.iast:
iti sva doṣān parikīrtitām tayā
samīkṣya buddhyā kṣaṇadā careśvaraḥ |
dhanena darpeṇa balena ca anvito
vicintayāmāsa ciram sa rāvaṇaḥ
verses.translation: In this way when Shuurpanakha extolled only his negative traits, he that lord of night-walkers Ravana, who holds only his pride, power and prosperity dear to him, pored them over in his mind and contemplated over a time.

glosses.meaning: with prosperity, pride, power, also, he who is with them
over a time, started to contemplate.
